classification_definitions.integration: Core assertion target materially crosses real embedded server/client/storage or OS/process/protocol boundary. Incidental setup alone is insufficient.
classification_definitions.unit: Core assertion target is local validation/decoding/data/concurrency/clock/logging or synthetic/stub API feed.
classification_definitions.mixed: Separate material local-only and genuine-boundary assertion blocks.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Insufficient connected source to resolve target type; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.

classification_interpretation: Source categories describe the boundary required by each core assertion target, not proof that canonical tests compile or execute. Statically stale setup is explicitly retained as blocker F1; target type can still be resolved from exact assertion and connected production source. Independent peer acceptance decides classification and promotion.

assertion_blocks.exact_text:
survivor := cluster.runtimes[(leaderIndex+1)%3]
	cluster.stop(leaderIndex)
	waitUntil(t, ctx, "new stream leader", func() bool {
		probe, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		existing, err := survivor.JetStream().Stream(probe, "FORMATION")
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		info, err := existing.Info(probe)
		return err == nil && info.Cluster != nil && info.Cluster.Leader != "" && info.Cluster.Leader != leader

roots.asserted_target: Signed documents relay through real home/mirror storage, remain readable during partition and catch up without spoke write authority.
roots.rationale: Start signed JWT/mTLS link regions; authority.Start uses real JetStream lease; OpenHome creates FileStorage stream and mirror consumers, OpenMirror creates real stream mirror. PutDocument -> put Guard/term reads/CAS PublishMsg -> leaf/proxy -> mirror Document GetLastMsgForSubject/gap-free Info -> Follow OrderedConsumer + verified Document -> test-owned callback VerifyCurrent/adoption channel. Partition closes proxy; reader returns prior generation from local replica; reopen catches up. Rogue/wrong-cell records are actually relayed before test callback refusal. Spoke JetStream/core Publish cannot alter home Document readback.
roots.limitations: Callback tracks generation in test memory and calls production cellspec.VerifyCurrent; it is not an actual app/controller adoption path. Keys, regions, fault and follower callback are test-owned. R1 regional stores only; no multi-broker fault quorum, production cloud/network or end-to-end deployment credit. Local verifier assertions depend on documents delivered by the genuine boundary, so no separate independent local-only block receives mixed credit.

func BrokerOperatorPublishPermissions(cell string) jwt.StringList {
	return jwt.StringList{
		protocol.DeliveryIntentSubject(cell), protocol.DeliveryArtifactAdmitSubject(cell), protocol.HostRegisterSubject(cell),
		protocol.PlacementApplySubject(cell), protocol.ManagedUpdatePrepareSubject(cell), protocol.MaterialPrepareSubject(cell),
		protocol.BackupOperationSubject(cell), protocol.BrokerClaimApplySubject(cell),
		protocol.TerminalSubject(cell, "plan"), protocol.TerminalSubject(cell, "apply"), protocol.TerminalSubject(cell, "status"),
		"$JS.API.INFO", "$JS.API.STREAM.INFO.TS_DELIVERY_INTENTS",
		"$JS.API.STREAM.INFO.OBJ_TS_ARTIFACTS",
		"$JS.API.STREAM.INFO.KV_TS_DELIVERY_ADMISSIONS",
		"$JS.API.STREAM.INFO.KV_TS_DELIVERY_OPERATIONS",
		"$JS.API.STREAM.INFO.KV_TS_HOST_STATE",
		"$JS.API.STREAM.INFO.TS_CONTROL_LOG",

		"$JS.API.STREAM.MSG.GET.KV_TS_DELIVERY_ADMISSIONS",
		"$JS.API.STREAM.MSG.GET.KV_TS_DELIVERY_OPERATIONS",
		"$JS.API.STREAM.MSG.GET.KV_TS_HOST_STATE",

func HomeStreamConfig(replicas int) jetstream.StreamConfig {
	return jetstream.StreamConfig{
		Name:              StreamName,
		Description:       "Fenced global region roster and database directory",
		Subjects:          []string{protocol.GlobalStateStreamSubject()},
		Retention:         jetstream.LimitsPolicy,
		MaxConsumers:      -1,
		MaxMsgs:           -1,
		MaxBytes:          -1,
		MaxMsgsPerSubject: -1,
		MaxMsgSize:        maxMessageBytes,
		Storage:           jetstream.FileStorage,
		Replicas:          replicas,
		DenyDelete:        true,
		DenyPurge:         true,
		AllowDirect:       false,
		Metadata:          map[string]string{"terrascale-contract": contract, "terrascale-role": "home"},
	}
}

func MirrorConsumerConfig(peer string, replicas int) jetstream.ConsumerConfig {
	return jetstream.ConsumerConfig{
		Durable:        protocol.GlobalMirrorConsumer(peer),
		Description:    "Durable source of a peer region's read-only global mirror",
		DeliverSubject: protocol.InterRegionGlobalDeliverSubject(peer),
		DeliverPolicy:  jetstream.DeliverAllPolicy,
		AckPolicy:      jetstream.AckFlowControlPolicy,
		FlowControl:    true,
		IdleHeartbeat:  mirrorHeartbeat,
		MaxAckPending:  mirrorMaxAckPending,
		Replicas:       replicas,
		Metadata:       map[string]string{"terrascale-contract": contract, "terrascale-role": "mirror-source", "terrascale-peer": peer},
	}
}

findings.detail: Retained roots/helper use Config{Lab:true}; canonical Config at runtime.go:131-148 has no Lab field. Production cfg.validate:611-618 also requires JWT/TLS, forbids NKey-seed configuration and embedded Users. Thus the old Lab/NKey setups do not establish a reachable current broker execution. Categories describe resolvable core assertion targets, not successful execution. Package-wide compilation cannot be claimed even for roots without Lab literals.

TestEmbeddedClusterAdvertisesClientPeers expects discovered peer client URLs, whereas canonical serverOptionsForStart uses DontListen=true and Cluster.NoAdvertise=true (714-715). No passing peer-advertisement behavior can be inferred.

TestInterRegionContractIsExplicitAndExact mutates interregion.DefaultPermissions to empty at lines 122-124; canonical ApplyInterRegion supplies deny-all defaults (494), and verify rejects anything not denyAll (570). This is local validation, not installed-server evidence. Mutation labels mentioning a previous union grant model grant no broker credit.

TestGlobalMirrorContractExportsNoConsumerCreation requires homeDefaults.Sub.Allow not contain the home query subject at lines 255-259; canonical leafPermissionsFor adds queries to Pub only and health to Sub. Those expectations match this direction. This is local generated-contract evidence only; no permission enforcement over leafnodes is asserted.
